caption: A rectangular yellow kitchen sponge with a green scouring-pad base sits on a white plate trimmed with a black rim, set against a dark background. Its top surface is already coated in a thick, glossy, dark layer that bubbles and churns, while wisps of steam rise steadily from it. From the upper-right corner, a transparent container tilts to pour a thin stream of clear liquid onto the sponge. The stream first strikes the yellowish right portion of the sponge, then shifts toward the center as the container moves. With each pour, the viscous layer spreads, thickens, and grows wetter, its bubbles enlarging and bursting across nearly the whole upper surface. A brownish pool of liquid gathers along the right edge of the sponge on the plate and slowly widens. The clear stream gradually thins and fades out. Yet the dark layer continues to bubble and the steam keeps rising.
